top_findings: Canonical production hostname successfully consolidated to single https://www.teleview.me domain with server-side 308 redirects
Comprehensive multi-page SSG architecture pre-rendering all 11 core routes with dedicated meta tags and breadcrumb hierarchy
Full JSON-LD structured data graph interconnecting Organization, WebSite, WebPage, Product, and Service entities without spam/fake review violations
High-speed Core Web Vitals optimization with LCP hero preloading, non-blocking font stylesheets, and 100% explicit image dimensions
Edge security headers and 1-year immutable caching configured in vercel.json
quick_wins: Add llms.txt and llms-full.txt in public/ for enhanced AI Search citation and grounding (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude)
Include potentialAction SearchAction on WebSite schema for sitelinks searchbox eligibility
Add outbound link to authoritative speed test tool (e.g. fast.com) in bandwidth FAQ to diversify external citation profile
Add automated daily/weekly sitemap ping to search engine indexers upon deployment

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Single canonical hostname (www.teleview.me) enforced at Vercel edge with 308 permanent redirects
Clean robots.txt allowing all crawlers and declaring sitemap.xml
Valid XML sitemap with 11 indexable URLs, exact changefreq and priority attributes
Security headers (HSTS 2-years, X-Frame-Options DENY, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Referrer-Policy)
Zero crawl errors, zero redirect chains, genuine 404 handler returning HTTP 404 status code

findings.title: Subpage Hero Preload Optimization
findings.description: The pre-renderer dynamically eliminates homepage hero preloads from all subpages, ensuring crawl bandwidth is reserved for page-specific assets.
findings.recommendation: Maintain dynamic resource hint hoisting during SSG build.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Comprehensive content depth with 2,671 words on homepage and 800-1,200 words across subpages
15+ years experience signals and clear 14-day refund policy supporting E-E-A-T
Natural keyword density (IPTV: 2.32%, streaming: 1.54%, subscription: 1.16%) with zero keyword stuffing
Comprehensive coverage of channel lineups, live sports bouquets, supported hardware, and troubleshooting

findings.title: External Educational Citations
findings.description: The website links to WhatsApp and email, but visible copy has minimal external educational links.
findings.recommendation: Add a link to fast.com or speedtest.net in the internet speed FAQ answer.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: All 11 pages have unique, compelling title tags within the optimal 40-60 character range
All meta descriptions fall within 140-160 characters with clear value propositions and CTAs
Strict semantic heading hierarchy on all pages with exactly one H1 per page
Rich contextual internal linking between hub, duration subpages, setup guides, and device lists

findings.title: Resolved Metadata Replacement Regex In Pre-renderer
findings.description: Fixed pre-rendering script replacer function to avoid regex dollar-sign capture group substitutions on priced titles.
findings.recommendation: All plan titles verified clean and correct.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Unified @graph JSON-LD structure on every page with stable @id entity references
Accurate Product and Offer entities for each subscription duration with ISO currency and real pricing
Strict compliance with Google Search spam guidelines (zero fake aggregate reviews or ratings)
Deep BreadcrumbList on all subpages matching site navigation path

findings.title: Sitelinks Searchbox Opportunity
findings.description: WebSite schema can be augmented with SearchAction if site search is enabled in the future.
findings.recommendation: Add potentialAction SearchAction template once search endpoint is implemented.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: LCP candidate preloaded with high fetchpriority and modern WebP format
Google Fonts stylesheet loaded asynchronously via print/swap pattern to eliminate render-blocking CSS
All images have explicit width and height dimensions, achieving zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS = 0)
Static pre-rendered HTML with minimal runtime JavaScript execution overhead

findings.title: Single-file bundle inlining
findings.description: Assets are currently bundled into pre-rendered HTML via viteSingleFile, which ensures high reliability across all hosts.
findings.recommendation: Continue using SSG pre-rendered HTML for maximum crawler indexability.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Pre-rendered HTML makes all content directly indexable by AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot)
Clean tabular plan comparison data and structured question/answer formats provide high citation surface
Wikidata entity mentions (IPTV Q11153, 4K resolution Q2816438, Streaming media Q11379) in schema

findings.title: Missing llms.txt standard file
findings.description: Adding an /llms.txt file provides an authoritative markdown summary directly consumable by LLM search engines.
findings.recommendation: Generate public/llms.txt summarizing Teleview plans, features, and FAQs.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 100% of images have descriptive alt attributes or explicit empty alt for decorative carousel clones
Modern formats (WebP, AVIF, SVG) used exclusively with legacy JPG fallbacks
Offscreen images configured with native loading="lazy" and decoding="async"
Every device logo and hero image has explicit width and height attributes

findings.title: Image Asset Hygiene
findings.description: All 27 images on the homepage meet Google PageSpeed and WCAG standards.
findings.recommendation: Maintain WebP/AVIF compression when adding new channel logos or banner images.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Verify DNS propagation of Vercel 308 permanent redirect from teleview.me to www.teleview.me
Submit https://www.teleview.me/sitemap.xml to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Deploy /llms.txt to provide structured context for generative AI search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude)
Add outbound speed test reference in bandwidth FAQ to enrich topic authority

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Create targeted hardware setup landing pages (e.g. /setup/firestick, /setup/tivimate)
Publish sports streaming calendar for upcoming marquee live events

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Monitor Google Search Console indexation status across all 11 pre-rendered routes
Track Core Web Vitals field data in PageSpeed Insights and Vercel Analytics
